task: Using only the case evidence you received, answer the next shift's audit in one JSON object with the keys below. For facts missing from your evidence use the string unknown. Give identifiers exactly when known. For status values use plain lower-case English. controlling_source (ID), controlling_revision (letter), crate_count (integer), gate (name), pickup (24-hour HH:MM), cancelled_source (ID), packing_authority (ID), permit_id (ID), permit_status (approved/pending/denied/unknown), notice_id (transaction ID), dispatch_transmission (sent/unsent/unknown), dispatch_receipt (confirmed/unconfirmed/unknown).
evidence:
North Annex shift record / display-crate transfer / Wednesday. Import watermark for the page layout: IMPORT-WATERMARK-RQ719.
08:12 — Early planning worksheet W-12, revision B: five crates via Alder Door for the 13:40 pickup. Facilities pencilled that into the whiteboard pending the next movement slip. The board was not a dispatch record.
09:36 — Signed movement slip MV-493, revision C, explicitly cancels W-12 rev B. Four crates via Birch Gate at 14:25. This is the controlling plan for the shift. The runner struck the old board entry.
09:51 — Collections lead's email EM-76 authorizes packing the four crates. The named site electrician has not returned a decision on the lift permit LP-28. The permit remains pending; packing authorization does not release the lift.
10:04 — Courier console transaction TX-816 says the routing notice was SENT to dispatch. The recipient-acknowledgment column is blank. No call or later acknowledgment is recorded. The 10:08 shift note confirms only that the sent item appears in the console.
10:10 — Security passed around the new laminated break schedule; the crew chose the smaller noticeboard. End of export.
